title: CoonsHandleBuilder shared de Casteljau utility
description: Extract the de Casteljau split + directed-handle-map pattern from CoonsLoopCutNode (lines 109-184, 278-301) into a shared utility in the same package. Other nodes (inset, extrude, mirror, merge) will use this to preserve bezier handles through topology changes.
definition-of-done: 1. CoonsHandleBuilder class created with split-at-t, directed-map, and flush-to-slots methods. 2. CoonsLoopCutNode refactored to use it (no behavior change). 3. Existing coons tests pass.
testing-plan: 1. CoonsCubeDslTest still produces the same vertex/face count. 2. Diff loop_cut output before/after refactor - identical positions and handles.
